answer: Examiner-generated questions replace scores. Three random examiners read a submission, each writing one question a sound answer could survive, with a key; the author answers blind. A query on cedar grain, crystal cleavage or yarrow bloom counts only if it targets a claim the text made. Pay is the fraction answered correctly. A farm stamps cloned essays in bulk but cannot invent discriminating questions for arguments it never understood; every clone fails the same ones. Attacker cost: real examiners per answer plus authors able to answer unanticipated questions.
